nodeShapes.name: cylinder
nodeShapes.definition: A cylinder of diameter `S` and height `phi * S`, axis along y.

nodeShapes.name: cone
nodeShapes.definition: A cone of base diameter `S` and height `phi * S`, apex up (+y).

nodeShapes.name: capsule
nodeShapes.definition: A capsule `S` tall, caps included, of radius `0.25 * S`.

nodeShapes.name: torus
nodeShapes.definition: A torus whose center line has diameter `S`, tube thickness `0.5 * S`.

nodeShapes.name: torus-knot
nodeShapes.definition: A (2, 3) torus knot of radius `0.3 * S` and tube radius `0.2 * S`.

nodeShapes.name: triangular_prism
nodeShapes.definition: The uniform triangular prism (Johnson-style, all edges equal), size `S`.

nodeShapes.name: square_pyramid
nodeShapes.definition: The equilateral square pyramid (Johnson solid J1), size `S`.

nodeShapes.name: geodesic
nodeShapes.definition: The geodesic polyhedron with m = 1, n = 0, size `S`.

nodeShapes.name: rectangle
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. The box `(-1,-1) (1,-1) (1,1) (-1,1)`, stretched to the node's width and height.

nodeShapes.name: round-rectangle
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. A rectangle whose four corners are quarter circles of radius `min(r, quarter of the shorter side)`; `r` is `shape.cornerRadius` (unset: none).

nodeShapes.name: top-round-rectangle
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. As `round-rectangle`, only the top two corners rounded.

nodeShapes.name: bottom-round-rectangle
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. As `round-rectangle`, only the bottom two corners rounded.

nodeShapes.name: ellipse
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. The ellipse filling the box.

nodeShapes.name: pentagon
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. The regular pentagon with a corner straight up, stretched to the box.

nodeShapes.name: hexagon
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. The regular hexagon with corners at 0 and 180 degrees, stretched to the box.

nodeShapes.name: octagon
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. The regular octagon with its first corner at 22.5 degrees, stretched to the box.

nodeShapes.name: star
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. A five-pointed star, first point straight up, inner radius 0.38 of the outer, stretched to the box.

nodeShapes.name: polygon
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. The corners `shape.points` lists, as fractions of the half width and half height; without usable corners, the rectangle.

nodeShapes.name: cross
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. A plus sign whose arms are a third of the box wide: corners at +-1/3 and +-1.

nodeShapes.name: man
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. Pajek 6.02's man figure (its SVG export path, `PAJEK_MAN` in shapeOutlines.ts), fitted to the box.

nodeShapes.name: woman
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. Pajek 6.02's woman figure (`PAJEK_WOMAN`), fitted to the box.

nodeShapes.name: none
nodeShapes.definition: No body: the node draws only its label, and its box (the rectangle) still bounds edges and the label.

nodeShapes.name: round-triangle
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. `triangle` with each corner rounded by a circular arc of radius `min(tenth of the shorter side, shape.cornerRadius)`.

nodeShapes.name: barrel
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. A rectangle whose corners are cut by quadratic curves a quarter of the width in and a twentieth of the height down (Cytoscape.js barrel).

nodeShapes.name: database
nodeShapes.definition: Flat. A cylinder seen from the side: straight sides, top and bottom the near halves of ellipses a third of the height tall (vis-network database).

edgeArrows.name: normal
edgeArrows.definition: Filled triangle `(0,0) (-1,-A/2) (-1,A/2)`.

edgeArrows.name: inverted
edgeArrows.definition: Filled triangle `(0,0) (1,-A/2) (1,A/2)`, placed so its base (x = 1) is at the node's surface: it points back along the line.

edgeArrows.name: dot
edgeArrows.definition: Filled disc of radius 0.5 centered on the cap point, 32 segments.

edgeArrows.name: sphere-dot
edgeArrows.definition: In 3D an unlit sphere of diameter 0.25 of the cap, centered on the cap point; in 2D the `dot` disc.

edgeArrows.name: open-dot
edgeArrows.definition: Ring centered on the cap point, outer radius 0.5, inner radius 0.3875.

edgeArrows.name: none
edgeArrows.definition: No cap; the line runs to the node.

edgeArrows.name: tee
edgeArrows.definition: Filled bar across the line: x from -0.5 to 0, z from -0.75 to 0.75.

edgeArrows.name: open-normal
edgeArrows.definition: Frame of the `normal` triangle.

edgeArrows.name: open-diamond
edgeArrows.definition: Frame of the `diamond`.

edgeArrows.name: box
edgeArrows.definition: Filled square x from -1 to 0, z from -0.5 to 0.5.

edgeArrows.name: half-open
edgeArrows.definition: Filled triangle `(0,0) (-1,-0.4) (-0.4,0)`. Line stop 0.4.

edgeArrows.name: vee
edgeArrows.definition: Filled concave `(0,0) (-1,-A/2) (-0.5,0) (-1,A/2)`. Line stop at the notch, never less than half the cap, longer for a wide line.

edgeArrows.name: half-circle
edgeArrows.definition: Filled half disc of radius 1 centered on the tip, from 90 to 270 degrees (flat side at the tip).

edgeArrows.name: open-half-circle
edgeArrows.definition: The `half-circle` arc as a band from radius 0.75 to 1.

edgeArrows.name: curve
edgeArrows.definition: A band from radius 0.75 to 1 centered at (-1,0), from -90 to 90 degrees (bulging toward the tip).

edgeArrows.name: triangle-tee
edgeArrows.definition: Filled triangle `(0,0) (-0.6,-0.3) (-0.6,0.3)` and a bar x from -1 to -0.8, z from -0.3 to 0.3.

edgeArrows.name: circle-triangle
edgeArrows.definition: A filled disc of radius 0.25 centered at (-0.25,0) and a triangle `(-0.5,0) (-1,-0.25) (-1,0.25)`.

edgeArrows.name: half-open-flipped
edgeArrows.definition: `half-open` reflected across the line: `(0,0) (-0.4,0) (-1,0.4)`. Line stop 0.4.

edgeArrows.name: open-box
edgeArrows.definition: The `box` square as a frame 0.1125 thick.

edgeArrows.name: image
edgeArrows.definition: The arrow's `image` picture on a flat quad standing on the line, tip at the origin. Without a picture, no cap.

edgeArrows.name: cross-delta
edgeArrows.definition: Filled delta `(0,0) (-2/3,-1/6) (-2/3,1/6)` and a bar x from -1 to -11/12, z from -0.25 to 0.25. Line stop 2/3.

edgeArrows.name: open-cross-delta
edgeArrows.definition: The delta as an outline 1/12 thick, and a filled bar x from -1 to -5/6, z from -0.25 to 0.25. Line stop 2/3.

edgeArrows.name: open-inverted
edgeArrows.definition: Triangle `(0,-A/2) (0,A/2) (-1,0)` as an outline 0.1125 thick.

edgeArrows.name: half-barb-flipped
edgeArrows.definition: `half-barb` reflected across the line. Line stop 0.2/1.135.

edgeArrows.name: inverted-vee
edgeArrows.definition: Two filled triangles `(-1,0) (-0.25,0) (0,-A/2)` and `(-1,0) (0,A/2) (-0.25,0)`: point on the line, notch empty.

edgeArrows.name: cross
edgeArrows.definition: Two strokes crossing on the line: `(-1,-0.5) (-0.15,0.5) (0,0.5) (-0.85,-0.5)` and its reflection across the line. Line stop 0.5.

edgeArrows.name: open-vee
edgeArrows.definition: `half-barb` and `half-barb-flipped` together. Line stop 0.5.

edgeArrows.name: slash
edgeArrows.definition: One stroke `(-1,-0.5-t) (-1,-0.5+t) (0,0.5+t) (0,0.5-t)`, t = sqrt(2)/16. The line runs on under it to the tip.

edgeArrows.name: stem
edgeArrows.definition: A length of the line itself: x from -1 to 0, as thick as the line.

edgeLines.name: dot
edgeLines.definition: Discs of diameter `W`, spaced by the period.

edgeLines.name: star
edgeLines.definition: Five-pointed stars `W` across, spaced by the period.

edgeLines.name: box
edgeLines.definition: Squares of side `W`, spaced by the period.

edgeLines.name: dash
edgeLines.definition: Dashes `3W` long and `W` wide, spaced by the period (`4.5W`, a gap of `1.5W`).

edgeLines.name: diamond
edgeLines.definition: Diamonds (squares turned 45 degrees) `W` across, spaced by the period.

edgeLines.name: dash-dot
edgeLines.definition: Alternating dashes `3W` long and discs `0.6W` across, each spaced by its own length.

edgeLines.name: sinewave
edgeLines.definition: A continuous sine wave of amplitude `W/2` and stroke `0.1W`, one period per segment of 0.75 scene units.

edgeLines.name: zigzag
edgeLines.definition: A continuous zigzag of amplitude `W/2` and stroke `0.1W`, its arms at 90 degrees, one period per segment of 0.75 scene units.

edgeLines.name: double
edgeLines.definition: Two thin bars `0.2W` thick at `+-0.4W` from the line's center, `4W` long; an element counts `2W` long, so at the period of `3W` the bars overlap into two lines.

edgeLines.name: forward-slash
edgeLines.definition: Strokes `0.3W` thick from `(-0.5W, W)` to `(0.5W, -W)` across the line; an element counts `W` long, spaced by the period.

edgeLines.name: backward-slash
edgeLines.definition: Strokes `0.3W` thick from `(-0.5W, -W)` to `(0.5W, W)`, spaced as `forward-slash`.

edgeLines.name: vertical-slash
edgeLines.definition: Strokes `0.3W` thick straight across the line from `-W` to `W`, spaced as `forward-slash`.

edgeLines.name: separate-arrow
edgeLines.definition: Small arrows `2W` long: a shaft `0.3W` thick from `-W` to `0.3W` and a head `(0.3W, 0.5W) (W, 0) (0.3W, -0.5W)`; one centered on the line's start and one every 0.5 scene units.

edgeLines.name: contiguous-arrow
edgeLines.definition: A bar `4W` long and `0.5W` thick with a chevron of two strokes `0.25W` thick meeting at `(0.5W, 0)` from `(-0.3W, +-0.8W)`; one centered on the start and one every `3W`.

transitions.name: glide
transitions.definition: Straight from old to new place, `easing` param: `linear`, `ease-in-out` (default, `ease`) or `spring` (`1 - e^(-6u) cos(4.5 pi u) (1 - u)`).

transitions.name: staggered-glide
transitions.definition: Each node glides as `glide` over a window of length `1 - 0.8 * stagger` (default stagger 0.5), starting at `order * (1 - length)`, where order is the node's distance from the center (`from` "center") or hops from the selection.

transitions.name: arc-move
transitions.definition: The eased straight path bowed to the left of travel within the x-y plane by `length * height * sin(pi u)`, length the whole move's (default height 0.3).

transitions.name: swirl
transitions.definition: Turns about the z axis through the origin: the angle goes from the old bearing to the new, at least `abs(turns)` whole turns in the sign of `turns` (default 0.5; 0 the shorter way), radius and z blended, all eased.

transitions.name: fade-through
transitions.definition: Each node dissolves into a puff of particles with no curl and moves inside it during `win(t, 0.3 + 0.15 seed, 0.25)`, eased.

transitions.name: collapse-bloom
transitions.definition: The old layout shrinks toward the origin to 4% of its size, holds for `hold` of the duration (default 0.1) while turning into the new layout at 4%, then blooms out (cubic ease out).

transitions.name: particle-morph
transitions.definition: Each node bursts into `particles` (default 24) particles that stream through curl noise (`curl`, default 1) while the node glides during `win(t, seed * 0.35, 0.65)`, eased.

labelLooks.name: default
labelLooks.definition: No values: the label draws with the renderer's own look.

labelLooks.name: card
labelLooks.definition: font Verdana, sans-serif; color #1a1a1a; background #ffffff; padding 6; cornerRadius 6; borderWidth 1; borderColor #8a8a8a.

labelLooks.name: dark
labelLooks.definition: font Verdana, sans-serif; color #ffffff; background #222222; padding 6; cornerRadius 6.

labelLooks.name: pill
labelLooks.definition: font Verdana, sans-serif; color #ffffff; background #1f5fa8; padding 8; cornerRadius 24; weight bold.

labelLooks.name: callout
labelLooks.definition: font Verdana, sans-serif; color #1a1a1a; background #fff4c2; padding 6; cornerRadius 6; pointer true; pointerDirection bottom.

nodeBorderStyles.name: zigzag
nodeBorderStyles.definition: A zigzag running round the node.

nodeBorderStyles.name: sinewave
nodeBorderStyles.definition: A sine wave running round the node.

nodeBorderStyles.name: forward-slash
nodeBorderStyles.definition: Short strokes across the ring, leaning forward.

nodeBorderStyles.name: backward-slash
nodeBorderStyles.definition: Short strokes across the ring, leaning back.

nodeBorderStyles.name: vertical-slash
nodeBorderStyles.definition: Short strokes straight across the ring.

nodeBorderStyles.name: separate-arrow
nodeBorderStyles.definition: A ring of small arrows chasing each other round it.

nodeBorderStyles.name: contiguous-arrow
nodeBorderStyles.definition: A bar of arrows joined head to tail.

nodeBorderPositions.name: outside
nodeBorderPositions.definition: Wholly outside the node's size (drawn when unset; informative).

nodeBorderPositions.name: center
nodeBorderPositions.definition: Centered on the node's edge, half in and half out.

nodeSizeModes.name: scale
nodeSizeModes.definition: `shape.size` multiplies each shape's own geometry (drawn when unset; informative).

nodeSizeModes.name: diameter
nodeSizeModes.definition: `shape.size` is the drawn shape's largest width, height or depth, 1 scene unit per unit.

nodeSizeModes.name: uniform
nodeSizeModes.definition: Every shape covers the same extent across the view, 1.5 scene units per unit (an icosphere's of size 1).

nodeLabelFits.name: inside
nodeLabelFits.definition: The label's padded box fits inside the node's outline.

nodeLabelFits.name: bounds
nodeLabelFits.definition: The label's padded box is the node's width and height.

nodeMeshDetails.name: full
nodeMeshDetails.definition: The shape's own mesh (drawn when unset; informative).

nodeMeshDetails.name: low
nodeMeshDetails.definition: An icosphere of one subdivision for a sphere; 8 segments around every other round shape.

nodeModelUpAxes.name: detected
nodeModelUpAxes.definition: Read from the model file's format.

nodeModelFits.name: contain
nodeModelFits.definition: Keeps the model's proportions inside the node.

nodeModelFits.name: stretch
nodeModelFits.definition: Stretched to the node's width, height and depth.

nodeModelCenters.name: bounds
nodeModelCenters.definition: The model's bounding box center is the pivot.

nodeModelCenters.name: origin
nodeModelCenters.definition: The model file's own origin is the pivot.

scales.name: linear
scales.definition: `t = (v - lo) / (hi - lo)`, clamped to [0, 1]; `lo = hi` gives 0.5. A `midpoint` `m` strictly between `lo` and `hi` maps `lo..m` onto `0..0.5` and `m..hi` onto `0.5..1`. A non-numeric or non-finite `v` is a miss.

scales.name: log
scales.definition: As `linear`, after taking log10 of `v`, `lo`, `hi` and `m`. A `v <= 0` is a miss, and a domain end `<= 0` makes every value a miss.

scales.name: sqrt
scales.definition: As `linear`, after `x -> sign(x) * abs(x)^0.5` on `v`, `lo`, `hi` and `m`.

scales.name: bins
scales.definition: `k` = `bins` (default 5, at least 1); with `t` as `linear` finds it, `slot = min(k - 1, floor(t * k))` and the output position is `slot / (k - 1)`, or 0 when `k = 1`. `lo = hi` gives 0.5. A non-numeric `v`, or a non-finite domain end, is a miss.

scales.name: quantile
scales.definition: Reads `thresholds`, ascending: `slot` = the number of thresholds at or below `v`, and the position is `slot / (number of thresholds)`, or 0 when there are none. `lo = hi` with every threshold equal to it gives 0.5. A non-numeric `v` is a miss. `bins` (default 4) is how many groups the thresholds were cut for.

scales.name: ordinal
scales.definition: The position is `i / (n - 1)` (0 when `n = 1`), `i` being the index of `v`'s text (README.md 11) in `categories` and `n` their count. A value not in `categories` is a miss.

scales.name: passthrough
scales.definition: The value itself is the channel value: a finite number or a string as it is, a boolean as `"true"` or `"false"`; anything else is a miss. Neither domain nor range is read.

scales.name: index
scales.definition: The order in which the value's text was first met, from 0; the same value keeps its number. It is not placed in the range and not reversed. A value with no text is a miss.

formats.name: json
formats.definition: a node-link or nodes-and-edges graph document, or the collection of rows `pointer` names

formats.name: csv
formats.definition: one table. A header in Neo4j's export form reads as Neo4j's node and relationship tables. Otherwise the rows are an edge table whose ends are the mapping's `source` and `target`, else the first pair of `source`/`target`, `src`/`dst` or `from`/`to` the header holds; with no pair, a header with an `id` column makes a node table. An edge table's distinct ends make the node table, each node keyed by its end's text. The first row is always the header

formats.name: pajek
formats.definition: the file's vertices and arcs or edges

formats.name: xgmml
formats.definition: the nodes and edges of the graph `graphIndex` or `graphName` picks

formats.name: cx
formats.definition: the nodes and edges of the network `graphIndex` or `graphName` picks

formats.name: cys
formats.definition: the nodes and edges of the session's network `graphIndex` or `graphName` picks

formats.name: obo
formats.definition: the terms as nodes and their relations as edges

formats.name: xlsx
formats.definition: the sheet `sheet` names, read as `csv` reads one table

dtypes.name: f32
dtypes.definition: numbers; the strings `"NaN"`, `"Infinity"` and `"-Infinity"`, and an integer's decimal string, read as numbers (README.md 11)

dtypes.name: json
dtypes.definition: any JSON value, `null` included as a value; the rows listed in the declaration's `unset` have no value
